items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: He had that Chopin touch, Beautiful.

ctx.x: in that bidet. (Laughter.) So then I come home now, I've got the job (inaudible). A lot of people were jealous people, all Latin people, they're loveable people but (inaudible). And if you stay away a long time, you become just like them.

So we had a boy on piano, his name was Chitterson, Herman Chitterson (PHONETIC), he was beautiful. He had that Chopin touch, Beautiful. And by the way, there was a boy named Bill Coleman, we were always in bands together. Me and him were playing (Cecil Scott) out of Cincinnati.
